messages:
sam: Anyone seeing a spike of 502/504s for hosted inference since ~14:02 UTC? Customer 'NomadLabs' is getting timeouts on /v1/generate and internal dashboards show a jump in gateway errors.

mira: Yep. Alerts started at ~14:00. KV-prefix layer (memcached) shows a surge in connection errors and a handful of shards reporting 5xx from the cache client.

devin: Proxy logs showing repeated upstream conn resets to memcached shard-7. Snippet: 
```
ERROR memcached_client.go:412 conn reset by peer: write tcp 10.3.7.21:11211->10.8.2.9:52344: write: connection reset by peer
WARN api_gateway.go:223 upstream 502 gateway returned for request id=nx-7a9f
```

opsbot: Incident INC-3929 created. Priority: P2. Oncall: carla. Link: https://incidents.redwood/INC-3929

carla: Taking this. Any quick repro steps from the customer? Is this tied to large prompts or streaming?

sam: Customer provided a repro: 
`curl -X POST https://api.redwood.run/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer <key>' -d '{"model":"gpt-4r","prompt":"<~5k tokens>","stream":true}'` -> 504 after ~30s. Happens intermittently but consistently over the past 20 minutes.

mira: Correlation: spikes align with a rotation job that ran at 13:58 UTC (memcached auth cert rollout). One shard shows auth handshake failures followed by connection churn and client-side circuit tripping.

carla: Two immediate mitigation options: 1) disable prefix lookup for affected tenant pool (quick flag), 2) route traffic to fallback model variant without prefix/cache checks. Which is faster?

devin: Flag is fastest. I'll flip PREFETCH_PREFIX=false for pool-7 via feature flags; change will hit frontends within ~60s. Also will increase memcached conn pool for shard-7 from 64->128 as a short term relief.

sam: Patch applied, flag rolled, increasing pool now. Monitoring dashboards...

mira: Error rate dropped from ~18% -> 2% over 3 minutes. Latency for affected requests back to normal. Customer (NomadLabs) confirms reduced errors: "looks much better, thank you".

carla: Good. Root-cause hypothesis: cert rotation caused ephemeral auth failures on memcached, clients retried aggressively and saturated pools -> conn resets -> gateway 502/504s. We'll need infra follow-up.

devin: Filing PR to add exponential backoff + circuit breaker tuning in kv-client (PR #4123). Also plan to add safer staged rollout for auth cert rotation to avoid mass reconnections.

mira: Action items: eng-infra to review cert rollout job (assigned), devex to add a runbook step to automatically disable prefix/cache lookups when kv error rate > 5% for >2m, and support to notify affected customers.

carla: I'll update INC-3929 with timeline and mark this thread as the support escalation. Closing on active mitigation; will keep incident open until postmortem. :white_check_mark: 

sam: Thanks all — NomadLabs is unblocked for now.

devin: Note for postmortem: consider backpressure metrics from kv client (conn errors, auth handshake failures) as signal to trigger traffic fallback automatically.

carla: Logged. Will follow up with a written postmortem and action owners.
